harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired the release publisher on node1. Publishing is now atomic, incomplete releases are rejected without changing current, both complete releases remain available for rollback, and the fix persisted across a verified node restart. Current points to releases/two.
actions_performed: Replaced rm/sleep/ln publication with same-directory temporary symlink plus atomic rename.
Added argument, directory, and MANIFEST validation.
Verified publication to release two and rollback to release one.
Stress-tested 200 switches with 3,695 concurrent reader checks and zero failures.
Restarted node1 safely and verified recovery with a changed boot identity.

evidence.summary: Root-owned executable installed using shell and GNU coreutils features available on the existing CentOS 5 platform.

evidence.requirement: Refuse releases missing MANIFEST and retain previous current target
evidence.summary: Publishing releases/incomplete returned rc=1; current remained releases/one with unchanged data.

evidence.requirement: Publish complete releases and retain rollback capability
evidence.summary: Release two published successfully, rollback to release one succeeded, and both staged releases remained intact.

evidence.requirement: Keep current continuously present and complete for concurrent readers
evidence.summary: Four concurrent readers completed 3,695 validations during 200 alternating publications with zero absent, incomplete, unreadable, or invalid observations.

evidence.requirement: Preserve installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 were unchanged before and after repair and restart.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; SSH became unavailable; boot ID changed from af8dc1e8-69be-42fb-8000-000000000000 to 7e9d62c6-b6de-4aba-8000-000000000000; publisher, SSH, current release, MANIFEST, staged data, rejection, rollback, and republish all recovered.
